title: Stickman Blade Fight
styleReference: Stickman silhouettes: solid ink and solid white figures, no faces, no line on the figures. Glowing blades as flat light shapes. Speed lines and impact frames.

cast.name: Shadow
cast.reference: A black stickman wielding a crimson energy katana. Fast, aggressive, unpredictable.

cast.name: Phantom
cast.reference: A white stickman wielding two electric-blue blades. Precise, defensive, and incredibly fast.

scenes.title: The Encounter
scenes.logline: In an abandoned temple at night in a thunderstorm, Shadow waits on a broken stair, and Phantom appears on the opposite rooftop in a flash of blue lightning and draws both blades.
scenes.props: crimson energy katana pointed at the ground; twin electric-blue blades; diagonal rain; lightning; cherry blossom petals

lines.speaker: Shadow
lines.text: You came all this way just to lose?

scenes.title: First Clash
scenes.logline: Phantom dashes in a blue streak and slashes; Shadow pivots past it, spins, and his crimson katana slams into Phantom's crossed blades in a burst of red and blue sparks that shatters the roof tiles.
scenes.props: crimson katana; twin blue blades crossed to block; sparks; shockwave; wet stone cracking; Phantom slides back; three-strike combination ends with the crimson blade splitting the courtyard

scenes.title: Blades of the Storm
scenes.logline: Phantom rushes in a zigzag of three blue afterimages; Shadow closes his eyes, blocks the real strike, and answers with a full-body spinning slash whose crimson wave throws Phantom through a wooden pillar.
scenes.props: twin blue blades charged with lightning; crimson katana held in both hands; rain freezing for an instant; afterimages; collapsing pillar; six midair clashes with white impact flashes

lines.speaker: Phantom
lines.text: Let's see if you can follow this.

scenes.title: Ultimate Techniques
scenes.logline: Shadow raises his blade and a burning crimson crescent moon forms behind him; Phantom rises in a column of blue lightning, crossing his blades in an X, and the two ultimate attacks collide in a shockwave that tears the storm clouds open.
scenes.props: crimson moon arc; levitating stones; Thunder Gate X-shaped energy trail; half a second of silence; circular shockwave; roof tiles flying; rain pushed away in a ring; white flash

scenes.title: The Final Frame
scenes.logline: In the smoking courtyard Phantom rises from his knees and makes one final dash; the two silhouettes pass each other, a thin red line flashes across the screen, and one blade falls to the stone.
scenes.props: cracked crimson katana; one blue blade embedded in the stone; a tiny blue spark; smoke; rain resumes; lightning
